scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: A new account copies Meera’s cousin’s photo and demands a voucher. It says the old phone is broken and offers a new number for checking. Kabir asks whether the suggested checking route is controlled by the same unverified sender.
scenes.speech: A new account copies Meera’s cousin’s photo and demands a voucher. It says the old phone is broken and offers a new number for checking. Kabir asks whether the suggested checking route is controlled by the same unverified sender.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A name, photograph or familiar detail can be copied or learned. Recognition is a useful clue, but it is not independent confirmation of an unusual request. The team separates what the message claims from what a trusted person can verify through a route already known before the message.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: Meera asks a caregiver to contact the cousin using the family’s saved number. She does not send a voucher, code or private detail while waiting. The class does not try to trap or accuse the sender; the goal is a safe independent check.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The new account supplies a new checking number. The family already has an older saved contact for the cousin. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The new account supplies a new checking number. The family already has an older saved contact for the cousin. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Ask a caregiver to use the pre-existing saved contact. A new number supplied inside the suspicious request is not an independent check of that same request.
scenes.speech: Ask a caregiver to use the pre-existing saved contact. A new number supplied inside the suspicious request is not an independent check of that same request.
scenes.dialogue: Choose a pre-existing independent verification route.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through identity claims, then a known contact route, then evidence before trust. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
